title: SAL-03 Warranty and service
summary: Cost centre SAL-03 covers warranty and service operations in unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner IMORGAN, with £450,323.52 budget remaining for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre SAL-03 covers Northbridge Cycles' Warranty and service operations within operational unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner IMORGAN [^r1]. Its status is OPEN [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre holds £450,323.52 in available budget for 2026-Q4 against an allocated budget of £505,000.00 [^r2].

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Cost centre code | SAL-03 [^r1] |
| Description | Warranty and service [^r1] |
| Operating unit | NBC-MAN-01 [^r1] |
| Owner | IMORGAN [^r1] |
| Status | OPEN [^r1] |

## Budget and spend

For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, SAL-03 has an assigned budget of £505,000 [^r2]. Committed spend stands at £54,676.48, leaving £450,323.52 available [^r2]. Detail lines and quarterly ledger extracts are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]].
